description: This is a Python script for a code linter and formatter, handling import sorting and code formatting using external tools like isort, usort, and ruff.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration for severity levels of lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a lint message with details about the issue.

methods.name: as_posix
methods.description: Converts a filename to POSIX format if on Windows.

methods.name: format_error_message
methods.description: Creates a LintMessage indicating a command failure.

methods.name: run_isort
methods.description: Runs isort on the given content and file path.

methods.name: run_usort
methods.description: Runs usort on the given content and file path.

methods.name: run_ruff_format
methods.description: Runs ruff formatter on the given content and file path.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Checks and formats a file, returning lint messages if formatting changes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and process files concurrently.
